sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Two Channels, Two Jobs

levels.entry: Only one of the two drains has been cleared.
The clear channel carries the quick flow; water seeps slowly through the reed bed.
The water leaving the reeds carries less suspended silt.
The water keeper needs one open channel and one planted one. Clearing both would remove half the system.
